description: This file contains functions related to inline editing of fields within the SuiteCRM framework, including rendering HTML for field editing, saving updated values, and formatting display values for different field types.

classes.name: SugarFieldHandler
classes.description: Handler class responsible for rendering SugarField type fields.

methods.name: getEditFieldHTML
methods.description: Generates the HTML markup for inline editing of a specific field in a module, with caching support for field templates.

methods.name: saveField
methods.description: Saves an updated value to a specified field of a bean record in the given module, handling access control and field type peculiarities.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Retrieves the formatted display value of a field for a bean, ensuring proper access control and handling sensitive fields.

methods.name: formatDisplayValue
methods.description: Formats the raw field value into HTML or human-readable form based on its type (e.g., date, enum, url, currency).

methods.name: getFieldValueFromModule
methods.description: Fetches the value of a specified field from a record in a given module.

methods.name: convertDateUserToDB
methods.description: Converts a user-input date string into a database-compatible datetime string.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has 'EditView' access to the provided bean.
